The KoffyKraft Roast Manual

How to use KoffyKraft Roast, from the plot to the cup. Each piece of help is written once and shows up wherever it belongs: in the moment of work it is about, and in every subject it touches. Read along the path, across a subject, or start from what you want to do.

Along the path

  1. StartRoast at a glanceWhat the app does, what it does not, and how one coffee's records hold together from the plant to the cup.
  2. StartOn your phoneOpen Roast, keep it on your home screen like any app, choose whether to have an account, and know what happens with no signal.
  3. StartYour first dayA walk around before you record anything: Home, the ?, Make it yours, Now and its tiles, and Find.
  4. PlotEstates and plotsWhere the coffee grows: the estate, each plot, its place on the map, the land check, soil and flowering, and what happens in the field from day to day.
  5. HarvestLogging a harvestOne record for each day's picking: which plots, how many kilos, how ripe, how sweet. The first link between a plot and the coffee that leaves it.
  6. Process runProcess runsFrom cherry to green coffee, one batch at a time: each step with its times, kilos and readings.
  7. Green lotGreen lotsThe green coffee itself: how much, what it cost, how dry, where it is kept, and what is left as roasts and sales draw on it.
  8. PassportPassports and selling into EuropeA QR for the bag that anyone can check, handing a lot to a buyer, and what a European buyer asks for under the deforestation rule.
  9. RoastRoastingSet up a roast from a green lot, time it, tap temperatures and events as they happen, then keep it in the Roastbook beside its graph and colour.
  10. CupBrewing and cuppingEach brew and each cupping, linked to the roast it came from, with timers, a dial-in guide, blind tasting tests and water you can mix yourself.
  11. BusinessRunning the businessThe people who work with you, the work they do, what you sell and are paid, the land papers and dues, and the names every form picks from.
  12. Your recordsYour recordsWhere your records live, how to keep a copy, how to take everything out, and how to leave. The records are yours; the app holds them in trust.
  13. HelpWhen something goes wrong, and the words usedThe usual snags and what to do about them, and the words the app uses, in plain language.

How this manual is made

One event, many views

A harvest happens once. Roast keeps it once, and you meet that same record on Now, in the Harvest list, as a source in a process run, in the green lot's chain and on the sack label. Nothing is typed twice, so nothing drifts apart.

This manual works the same way. Each piece of help is written once, at the moment of work it belongs to. The path, the subjects, the map and I want to are views of that one piece, so when it changes, every view changes with it.

What lasts, and what can change

In Roast, your records are what lasts. Screens, pages and exports can change around them, and the records stay as they were. Here too: the pieces of help stay, while the pictures are retaken from the app whenever it changes, the views can be rearranged, and any page, section or subject can leave as a copy you print or save.

Every button named here is checked against the app before these pages are made, and every picture is the real app filled with a made-up estate. Looking a feature up rather than learning it? The Roast guide lists them all on one page. Advice in the app is a guide, not a guarantee or a certificate. Questions: info@koffykraft.com.
